weather.title: Weather
weather.banner.firmware: Your radio has firmware %@. Weather needs MeshCore 1.15 or newer.
weather.banner.channelMissing: #meshwx isn't set up on your radio.
weather.banner.noBot: No weather radio heard yet. They appear as nodes named like WX-AUS.
weather.channel.alert.title: Add #meshwx to your radio?
weather.channel.alert.message: Weather radios broadcast on #meshwx. Its key comes from its name, so there is nothing secret to share.
weather.channel.full: No free channel slot. Remove a channel in Chats to make room.
weather.channel.notSynced: Your radio is still syncing its channels. Try again when it has finished.
weather.channel.slotInUse: Slot %lld on your radio is in use, so nothing was changed.
weather.place.choosePrompt: Choose a place in Places to see weather for it.
weather.place.outsideArea: Warnings aren't pushed here — pull to check.
weather.place.useMyLocationPrompt: See the weather where you are.
weather.alerts.sourceGeneric: National Weather Service alerts via weather radios
weather.alertStatus.noPlace: Choose a place to see which alerts cover it
weather.alertStatus.outOfCoverage: %1$@ is outside %2$@'s area, so alerts there are unknown.
weather.alertStatus.notChecked: This phone hasn't received %@'s alert list yet, so it can't tell whether any alerts are active. The list comes every 3 hours.
weather.alertStatus.feedNone: %@ hasn't received anything from the Weather Service. New alerts may not reach you.
weather.alertStatus.feedQuiet: %1$@ hasn't had anything from its home Weather Service office for %2$@. That's normal on a quiet night, but its feed could also be down.
weather.alertStatus.radioOffline: Your radio isn't connected. Last alert list as of %@.
weather.alertStatus.missedMessages: This phone missed messages from %@. Some alerts may be missing.
weather.alertStatus.coverageUnknown: %@ hasn't sent its station report yet, so the area it covers isn't known. It comes about every hour.
weather.alertsList.title: Alerts in %@'s area
weather.alertsList.openMap: Map of alerts. Opens the full map.
weather.alertsList.notAvailable: Listed, but %@ didn't have it when asked
weather.alertDetail.gone: No longer held by this phone
weather.now.empty: No current conditions yet. %@ broadcasts them every hour.
weather.conditions.ask: No current conditions for %1$@. Pull down to ask %2$@ for %3$@.
weather.conditions.askBlocked: No current conditions for %1$@. The nearest station is %2$@.
weather.empty.title: No weather for %@ yet.

weather.empty.nothing: There's no weather station or forecast point near %@.
weather.forecast.missingFar: No forecast for %1$@ yet. The nearest forecast point is %2$@, %3$@.
weather.stations.title: Weather stations

weather.station.notInBatch: Answered on request, not in the hourly batch
weather.station.nothingHeld: No reading from this station yet.
weather.reports.title: Weather Service text reports
weather.reports.discussion.title: Forecast discussion
weather.reports.outlook.title: Hazardous weather outlook
weather.reports.outlook.description: Hazards expected over the next week
weather.reports.storms.title: Storm reports
weather.reports.storms.description: Hail, wind and tornado reports from spotters
weather.reports.rainfall.title: Rainfall totals
weather.reports.space.title: Space weather
weather.reports.needsPlace: Choose a place to ask for this.
weather.request.publicNote: Everyone listening on #meshwx gets the answer.
weather.request.noAnswer: No answer at %1$@. %2$@ may be out of range or busy.
weather.request.heardNoAnswer: %1$@ was heard but didn't answer at %2$@. It may be busy.
weather.request.receivedNoAnswer: %1$@ received the request, but no answer reached this phone by %2$@. It may be busy, or its answer was lost.
weather.request.failed: Your radio couldn't send this at %@.
weather.request.rateLimited: Wait a few seconds between requests
weather.request.quiet: %1$@ not heard since %2$@ — it may not answer
weather.request.blocked.firmware: Your radio's firmware can't ask for weather

weather.request.blocked.noBot: No weather radio to ask yet
weather.request.blocked.notAnnounced: Can't ask until it announces itself
weather.request.notAvailable.noData: %@ has no data for that yet
weather.request.notAvailable.busy: %@ is busy, try again in a few minutes
weather.update.item.areaAlerts: alerts for this county and zone
weather.picker.unknownZipHint: PO box and some business ZIP codes aren't listed. Try the town instead.
weather.about.line1: Your request goes to the weather radio as a private message.
weather.about.line3: Every phone listening keeps it, including the answers to other people's requests.
weather.about.line4: Asking costs airtime everyone on the channel shares.
weather.about.radiosFooter: Requests go to the weather radio in use.
weather.about.feedQuiet: nothing from its Weather Service office for %@
weather.about.clearFooter: Removes everything received from %@ from this phone.
weather.about.alert.title: Clear weather received from %@?
weather.about.alert.message: Its alerts, readings, forecasts and reports are removed from this phone. They come back as %@ broadcasts them.
weather.covers.everywhere: Everything its Weather Service feed carries
weather.covers.none: %@ hasn't said what it covers yet.
weather.covers.noneFooter: Without it this phone can't tell a place outside its area from one it hasn't been told about, so it claims neither.
weather.requests.footer: What this phone asked for. Every answer was broadcast, so everyone listening got it too.
weather.requests.none: This phone hasn't asked for anything yet.
weather.heard.footer: What the channel carried recently, broadcasts and answers alike. This phone can't tell who asked.
weather.cache.title: Cached from the channel
weather.cache.intro: Everything here was overheard on #meshwx. This phone can't tell who asked for any of it.
weather.notifications.title: Alert notifications
weather.notifications.empty: No place is watched yet. Turn on the bell beside a place in Places, and a warning covering it will notify you.
weather.notifications.disconnected: Not watching — your radio isn't connected
weather.notifications.noPosition: No position yet. Open Weather with location turned on to give it one.
weather.notifications.otherWarningsDetai: Flood, winter storm, wind and the rest, delivered silently.
weather.notifications.tornadoNearbyDetai: Within 50 km, even when they don't cover the place.
weather.notifications.stormsAlways: Tornado, Extreme Wind, Flash Flood and Severe Thunderstorm Warnings covering a watched place always notify, with a sound. Watches, advisories and statements never do.
weather.notifications.promise: Alerts arrive only while your radio is connected and in range, and while DigitainoMesh is running. This is not a substitute for a NOAA weather radio or your phone's emergency alerts.
weather.notifications.denied: Notifications are off for DigitainoMesh, so a bell can't ring.
weather.notifications.stopWatching: Stop notifying me about warnings for %@
weather.notifications.late: Received late — sent while your radio was out of range.
weather.areaMap.title: Alert map
weather.areaMap.askAreaFootnote: One packet to %@, and the answer goes to everyone listening.
weather.areaMap.empty: No map yet. Nothing asks for one on its own — a map costs the shared channel several packets, so it waits for your tap.
weather.areaMap.cut: Cut to fit — an area not shaded here may still be under an alert
weather.areaMap.clear: %@ found nothing under an alert anywhere in the country.
weather.areaMap.noOutline: %lld of them have no outline in this app and aren't shaded
weather.areaMap.noOutlineOne: 1 of them has no outline in this app and isn't shaded
weather.areaMap.cost: About %lld packets on the shared channel.
weather.areaMap.costOne: About 1 packet on the shared channel.
weather.areaMap.tapHint: Tap a shaded area to ask %@ what it is.
weather.areaMap.mapLabel: Map of the country, with the areas under an alert shaded
weather.areaMap.busy: Another radio asked %@ for the map recently — try again in a few minutes.
weather.areaMap.partStatesUnknown: Part of the country, states not known
weather.areaMap.partReplaced: A newer part above covers these states.
weather.areaMap.notAsked: The rest of the country was not asked for. A state outside this map is unknown, not clear.
weather.areaMap.tooManyStates: More than %lld states asks for the whole country.
weather.areaMap.onMapAsOf: On the map as of %@. Details not received.

weather.traffic.subtitle: Everything heard on #meshwx, newest at the bottom.
weather.traffic.empty: Nothing heard on this channel yet.
weather.traffic.clearMessage: This removes the %lld rows this phone kept of what went past on #meshwx. The weather it has stored is not touched.
weather.traffic.notDecoded: This app could not read this datagram.
weather.traffic.detail.scopedUnknown: scoped, states not in this packet
